name: Cinchona
source: Dried bark of cultivated Cinchona species/hybrids as described in the supplied pharmacognosy material.
description: Study record focused on bark morphology, transverse section and diagnostic microscopy.

name: Cinnamon
source: Dried bark of the shoots of coppiced trees, as described in the supplied material.
constituents: Volatile oil, mainly cinnamic aldehyde, with eugenol, terpenes, mucilage, starch, calcium oxalate and tannin.
uses: Carminative, flavouring agent, mild astringent, aromatic.
description: Study record focused on bark structure, lignified elements, oil cells and diagnostic tests.

name: Clove
source: Dried flower buds, with clove oil, as described in the supplied pharmacognosy material.
constituents: Eugenol, isoeugenol, methyl/dimethyl furfural, caryophyllene and hydrolysable tannins.
uses: Carminative, aromatic, stimulant, antiseptic, flavouring agent and dental analgesic oil.
description: Study record focused on flower-bud anatomy, oil glands, vascular bundles and powder characters.

name: Dill
source: Dried ripe fruits of Anethum graveolens Linn., containing volatile oil.
constituents: Volatile oil, with carvone and other components described in the supplied material.
description: Study record focused on fruit anatomy, vittae, endosperm and diagnostic powder characters.

name: Ephedra
source: Dried stems of Ephedra species described in the supplied material.
uses: Sympathomimetic uses are described in the supplied pharmacognosy material.
description: Study record focused on stem anatomy, ridges, fibres, vascular bundles and powder characters.
